notes: Playlists are recovered from SideCut’s own on-device backup when the saved list goes missing, instead of being quietly reset to a single list.
The fault that could stop the whole page from running is repaired, so the app opens normally on every launch.
Lyrics auto-scroll now follows songs that switch language, switch speed, or open on a long intro and end on a long outro far more closely.
Your songs, playlists and saved lyrics stay on your device — nothing in your library is removed by this release.
